description: [Commercial Transit / Mobility] Submits EU261 / UK261 air passenger rights claims for delayed, cancelled or overbooked flights with compensation up to 600 EUR via vetted legal recovery partners.

delay_hours.description: Delay duration at final destination in hours

flight_number.description: Airline flight code (e.g. IB3166, BA456, LX2804)

session_id.description: Optional product session id. If omitted, GEO360 creates one (trip_*). Pass the same id on later search/commit calls for the same trip.

sub_id.description: Optional affiliate sub-ID for calling agent attribution

name: geo360_claim_flight_delay
